title: Read the app information of an app encryption declaration

summary.text: Use `GET-v1-apps-_id_-appEncryptionDeclarations` to update the relationship to an app encryption declaration instead.

abstract.text: Get the app information from a specific app encryption declaration.
An opaque resource ID that uniquely identifies the resource. Obtain the app encryption declaration resource ID from the `GET-v1-appEncryptionDeclarations` response.
Additional fields to include for each app resource returned by the response.
